definitions.explanation: Taking multiple photographs in rapid succession by holding down the shutter button. A standard feature on digital cameras and smartphones used to capture fast-moving subjects.

examples.japanese: {連写|れんしゃ}モードに{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
{動|うご}きの{速|はや}い{被写体|ひしゃたい}には{連写|れんしゃ}が{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Burst mode is convenient for fast-moving subjects.

examples.japanese: このカメラは{一秒間|いちびょうかん}に{最大|さいだい}{二十枚|にじゅうまい}の{連写|れんしゃ}が{可能|かのう}だ。
examples.english: This camera is capable of shooting up to twenty frames per second in burst mode.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {連|れん} (continuous) + {写|しゃ} (photograph). Used primarily in photography and camera discussions. Also used as a suru verb: {連写|れんしゃ}する (to shoot in burst mode).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連写|れんしゃ}モード (burst/continuous shooting mode)
- {連写|れんしゃ}{速度|そくど} (burst shooting speed)
- {高速|こうそく}{連写|れんしゃ} (high-speed burst shooting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単写|たんしゃ}: single-shot mode — taking one photo at a time
- {連続撮影|れんぞくさつえい}: continuous shooting — a more formal synonym
